benchmark: FC2 V1 rerun -- T4/T5 direction selectivity, class-2 graded per-type temporal dynamics on a right-eye patch
band: PASS iff pooled per-cell median DSI >= 0.3 (T4 on ON bar, T5 on OFF bar) AND T4a-d distinct preferred directions >= 3 AND T5a-d distinct >= 3 AND defined-DSI fraction >= 0.5; preregistered before the sweep
class1_result: FAILED at all 21 operating points (best pooled median DSI 0.288 at gain 0.8/leak 0.1); results/benchmarks/visual_motion.json
model: graded leaky integrator, flyvision form (doc section 1); signed raw MaleCNS counts; alpha=0.01*mean pair count; Vrest=0.5; relu at synapse; forward Euler dt=2ms
ct1: EXCLUDED (2 point cells in MaleCNS; unsplit CT1 sums the visual field, doc R1/I4). T5 therefore has no CT1(Lo1) trailing inhibition; its DS must come from slow-Tm9 leading excitation vs fast center.

sign_audit.note: 0 expected: measured MaleCNS consensus NT agrees with the curated table for every patch type

patch_geometry.column_source: assignedOlHex1/2 (raw annotations feather); Tm3/L4/T4/T5 by connectivity centroid (validated: median err 0.06 col)

calibration_declared: one global gain per configuration, chosen on a held-out edge moving along the +45deg diagonal (not among the 4 scored directions) at 5 col/s in both polarities; log-grid argmin |log(median peak evoked over T4-on-ON u T5-on-OFF / 0.5)| subject to stability; scored on the 4 cardinal directions x 2 polarities x 3 speeds
expected_tier_note: repo base rate for expected-to-help changes is 0/11; pass/fail here is open until run

readout_instrument_history.v1_wholesweep: first preregistered readout: evoked integrated over the whole sweep. MEASURED artifact (run 1, 2026-09-29): all 8 heterogeneous configs 0.104-0.107 median DSI AND uniform-tau control 0.1072 -- statistic is tau-independent, not the correlator. Trace probe measured median 84.6% of the evoked integral is standing post-transient DC (edge = permanent luminance step; DC gain is 1 at every tau).
readout_instrument_history.v2_crossing_window: corrected instrument, adopted before any v2 number was seen: evoked integrated only in the per-cell stimulus-locked window [front 2 columns before cell, 0.75 s after front passes cell] (sizes ASSUMED); direction-symmetric by construction. Band and calibration unchanged. Both readouts scored from the same simulations.
